EXAMINER REFERENCE CARD
Chromium History database

Useful commands:
  file History
  sqlite3 History
  .tables
  .schema downloads

Useful fields in `downloads`:
  target_path
  start_time
  tab_url
  site_url
  mime_type

Chromium/WebKit timestamp conversion:
  datetime(start_time / 1000000 - 11644473600, 'unixepoch')

Example query pattern:
  SELECT target_path, tab_url,
         datetime(start_time / 1000000 - 11644473600, 'unixepoch')
  FROM downloads;
